mapper.sql: WITH org00 AS (SELECT * FROM getOrg(#{companyId}, f_today())) SELECT sys05_user_role_id AS user_role_id, sys05_user_id AS user_id, sys05_role_id AS role_id, sys05_seq AS seq, sys05_note AS note, sys05_auth_org_id AS auth_org_id, f_org_nm(sys05_auth_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS auth_org_nm, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_nm, org00_kor_nm AS org_nm, f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_nm FROM sys05_user_role , emp01_person , emp03_trans , org00

AND sys05_user_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate()) AND emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_org_code_id = org00_org_id AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date )
mapper.select:
WHERE sys05_role_id = #{roleId}
ORDER BY org00_org_cd, f_org_seq(org00_org_id, emp03_trans_date, emp01_company_id), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd), f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys05_user_role (sys05_user_role_id, sys05_user_id, sys05_role_id, sys05_seq, sys05_note, sys05_auth_org_id) SELECT #{userRoleId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{seq}, #{note}, #{authOrgId} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys04_role WHERE sys04_role_id = #{roleId} AND sys04_company_id = #{companyId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys05_user_role WHERE sys05_role_id IN (SELECT sys04_role_id FROM sys04_role WHERE sys04_company_id = #{companyId}) AND sys05_user_role_id IN #{id}
